purpose: Seven scoped source fixes for Vulkan pipeline lifetime, VT copy layout, reentrant MRQ cancellation, retained scene depth cleanup, effective depth/stencil attachment tracking, empty split-barrier event lifetime, and requested DDC chunk generation consistency in UE5.6.1.

fixes.evidence: Saved/RenderRuns/root_cause_20261020_235808/mrq_cancellation_fix/proposal.json; extracted-method CPU regression reproduces old reentrant shot-array invalidation and passes with RequestShutdown.

fixes.change: Clear PartialDepth together with Depth in FSceneTextureExtracts::Release, including ReleaseRHI shutdown. The omitted owning reference could retain one SceneDepthZ image until device teardown.

fixes.change: Use the same effective depth/stencil binding for RDG access collection and render-pass construction. For desktop Vulkan SM6 single-sample persistent PF_DepthStencil attachments without a resolve target, change an unused aspect to read access with ELoad when the other aspect is active. Other RHIs/formats/sample counts/memoryless/resolve cases remain unchanged.
fixes.runtime_validation: Historical six-fix runs passed at one/four/eight workers; the final seven-fix build also passed the complete twelve-worker controlled cold-cache run. See the corresponding runtime records; finite acceptance does not establish indefinite stability.

fixes.change: Before allocating a split-barrier event, require at least one non-null resource whose AccessAfter is not exactly Discard. This matches the converter skip predicate; empty/null/discard-only transitions otherwise allocate an event that neither barrier half records or returns to the pool.
fixes.runtime_evidence_scope: Tracked leaked VkEvent 0x8926550000003a14 originated in GetBarrierEvent called by RHICreateTransition; source proves the no-barrier ownership gap. After the fix, tier_01 completed both job waves with no VVL errors at shutdown.
fixes.runtime_validation: Historical six-fix runs passed at one/four/eight workers; the final seven-fix build also passed the complete twelve-worker controlled cold-cache run. See the corresponding runtime records; finite acceptance does not establish indefinite stability.

fixes.change: Include requested RawHash in filesystem chunk reader reuse. Resolve missing or mismatched record generations by content-addressed data through the existing partial-read helper, validating the compressed header hash and obtaining its actual raw size. Preserve query policies, disabled-store behavior, simulated misses and SkipData semantics. Reject mismatched successful chunk responses in the hierarchy so lower nodes can return the requested generation.
fixes.diagnostics: LogDerivedDataCache Verbose reports key/id and expected versus record/response hash for fallback/rejection; VeryVerbose reports successful content-hash resolution and raw size.
fixes.causality_scope: The controlled seven-fix cold twelve-worker run captured expectedRawHash != recordRawHash for three StaticMesh keys and entered content-addressed fallback, then completed all 24 sequences and clean shutdowns. This confirms the mechanism occurs live and the corrected path completes this finite workload. The prior failed run did not capture the expected/actual hash of each failed page; no claim about all historical driver Xid causes.

reproduction_steps: Verify the original Build.version and all original_sha256 values before changing anything. Use a fresh independent clone, cp -a --reflink=auto, never cp -al or hardlinks.
Apply the combined patch only inside the clone: git -C <clone> apply --check <absolute-patch>, then git -C <clone> apply <absolute-patch>.

Build VulkanRHI, MovieRenderPipelineCore, Renderer, RenderCore, and DerivedDataCache serially. For each module, temporarily rename clone/Engine/Build/InstalledBuild.txt and set bUsePrecompiled = false only in that module Build.cs constructor. Keep -UsePrecompiled so dependencies use installed binaries.

Before actual compilation, run the recorded planning command with -WriteOutdatedActions. Review every compile/link action: only the selected module and necessary shared PCH may rebuild, and all outputs must remain inside the clone. UBT action export deletes outdated outputs, so never run this against the original engine.

Run the recorded actual build command. Paths and build user may be adapted to a fresh equivalent clone; outputs below record this machine build and are not a promise of byte-identical artifacts at another path.

After each build, restore the stock InstalledBuild.txt, the stock module Build.cs and the six stock UE5Rules/UE5ProgramRules DLL/PDB/Manifest files from the original engine. Keep patched C++ sources and rebuilt module artifacts. The stock rule assemblies prevent unrelated project/plugin builds from inheriting temporary compilation rules.

Verify original hashes remain unchanged, patched source hashes match, both UnrealEditor.modules BuildIds remain43139311, and all previously rebuilt modules are preserved during each subsequent build. Compare dynamic exports and run ldd -r with LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<clone>/Engine/Binaries/Linux for dependency resolution.
Use the cloned editor for bounded runtime validation before production. CPU compilation/link checks alone do not establish Vulkan validation cleanliness or high-concurrency stability.
